environment_note: Captured by direct page fetch from the authoring sandbox, NOT from a GitHub Actions runner. This distinction is the finding: ten earlier sessions recorded HLTV, EGamersWorld and the aggregators as 403/410 from the runner and concluded no external evidence existed for the model-only fixtures. On this path HLTV answers HTTP 200. The runner-only loader in scripts/build.py::load_no_line_research deliberately ignores this record, so nothing here can enter the priced ladder; it is published as evidence and as a correction to the reachability claim.
brief_line: Look for information sources to guide pick selections only for any matches that cannot be resolved in the same way as the featured picks. Try hltv, then try looking at esportsbooks and esports betting lines.
method: HLTV first, then esportsbooks and betting lines, for each of the 8 fixtures the live ladder could only price with a research model. Every page was read at observation time; no cached snippet was adopted. Nothing here produced a probability, a pick or an alias.

observations.verdict: reachable, publishes no real price — every bookmaker cell renders the template value 1.23
observations.reason: The page is titled 'odds & prediction' but the handicap table prints the identical value 1.23 against eOddset and Betway on every row for both teams, which is an unpopulated template, not a quote. A scraper that read the first decimal it found would publish a fabricated 1.23/1.23 price; the repository's identical-price placeholder rule rejects exactly this. The stand-in and ranking sentences are real official observations and are recorded as evidence.

observations.verdict: excluded by rule 2 — a fan vote is not a price
observations.reason: Recorded because it materially contradicts the money line for the same fixture (Hotspawn 1083014 is priced K27 0.565 / Virtus.pro 0.435 from an external market, and esports-news.co.uk's bookmaker prices K27 1.76 / Virtus.pro 2.05, a 0.538/0.462 de-vig). The community vote favours the side that both the market and HLTV's own ranking sentence disfavour, and HLTV notes Virtus.pro is fielding a stand-in. It changes nothing: rule 2 excludes fan votes and Hotspawn participation percentages alike. Published as a review item so the disagreement is visible rather than hidden.

observations.verdict: the fixtures ARE listed on Polymarket by exact name and start, but every market has zero traded volume, so there is no two-sided book to normalize
observations.reason: This is the direct answer to the brief's 'not covered on some betting sites like polymarket'. Two of the three DFRAG events bind to Hotspawn fixtures by exact team names and by start time (Oct 25 11:00 PM ET = 2026-10-26T03:00:00Z = Hotspawn 1082858; Oct 26 11:00 PM ET = 2026-10-27T03:00:00Z = Hotspawn 1082861). Both are labelled $0 vol, so rule 3's positive bid/ask size and non-crossed-book tests cannot pass and no order book is fetched. Rooster vs Abyssal displays 2.00x/2.00x at 50%/50%, which is an unpriced listing default; adopting it would fabricate the exact 50/50 the repository forbids. Directory percentages are excluded inputs by rule 3, so Ground Zero 27% / Off Chops 74% is recorded as evidence of the listing and NOT adopted; it disagrees with our own results-network estimate (0.4492 / 0.5508) and is flagged for review rather than used.

observations.verdict: reachable, but both pages display the identical 1.8/1.8 site placeholder — no bookmaker-average sentence, so nothing to replay
observations.reason: EGamersWorld answered HTTP 200 on this fetch path (earlier sessions recorded 403 from the runner). Both fixtures bind by exact names, tournament and Bo3 format, and both publish five-player lineups, which is usable identity evidence. Neither publishes a price: 1.8 on both sides is the site's unpopulated default and scripts/reference_odds.py already rejects identical prices as placeholders. A cached search snippet for the same fixtures showed 2.39/1.51 and 1.36/2.88 on 19 October, so EGamersWorld's odds do appear and disappear; only a same-session read is admissible, and this one had none.

observations.verdict: start time binds exactly to Hotspawn 1082861, price is the 1.8 placeholder, and two identity/location conflicts are recorded
observations.reason: The page's own schema.org JSON-LD gives startDate 2026-10-27T03:00:00.000Z, which is Hotspawn 1082861's published start to the second — the strongest binding available for this fixture. It still prices nothing (1.8/1.8). Two conflicts are flagged, not resolved: EGamersWorld calls the away side 'Team Abyssal' where Hotspawn says 'Abyssal', which is an unregistered alias and is not auto-joined; and its location says Sydney while HLTV's DFRAG Invitational 2026 event page and Liquipedia both say Brisbane, Australia.

observations.verdict: a reachable aggregator that names five bookmakers per match, but it carries no price for the model-only fixtures, and its own power rating is not an input
observations.reason: This surface was not in any earlier session's ladder. It publishes decimal prices inline for fixtures the repository already prices from first-party sources (corroboration only) and a per-match 'Match odds (5 bookmakers)' table naming Bet365, 1xbet, Betway, Stake and GG.bet. For Hotspawn 1081605's slot it publishes no odds, only the site's own 43%/57% power rating, which is that site's model and is excluded exactly like Hotspawn participation percentages. Operational limitation verified: the finished match page /matches/cs2/6yubojlbl-vs-ex-6666-1746763/ renders no odds table at all, so the bookmaker table is prematch-only and must be captured before the start, or it is gone.

conclusions.summary: No two-sided prematch price exists for any of the 8 model-only fixtures on any surface read at 2026-10-23T09:47Z-10:05Z, so every published estimate stands unchanged and nothing was invented. What IS new: HLTV is reachable on this path and publishes the format, both lineups and both world/VRS ranks for the fixtures checked; Polymarket does list two of them by exact name and start but at $0 traded volume, which is the precise, source-linked reason the featured method cannot resolve them; and three surfaces publish placeholder prices (EGamersWorld 1.8/1.8, HLTV analytics 1.23, Polymarket 2.00x/2.00x) that a naive scraper would have turned into fabricated probabilities.
